message: `spawn-slot` may panic here, and a module of this package, held to no panic by default (`--allow-panics` relaxes the modules `noPanic` does not list), may keep no panic site but out of memory: `k` is not proven to be a slot of `dst` here, and `spawn` panics on one that is not: guard it with a test that reaches the access — `if (k >= 0 && k < dst.length)` proves both ends, and an unsigned index needs only the upper one
